lines.speaker: reyes
lines.text: Door is open. Kell has the cameras looping for ninety seconds.

lines.speaker: kell
lines.text: Remote and offended you thought I would enter a detention block without a rifle.

lines.speaker: broadcast
lines.text: The traitor Vale orchestrated violence at Hollowmere to conceal an extremist alliance.

lines.speaker: reyes
lines.text: They published that before your interrogation ended.

lines.speaker: vale
lines.text: Then we keep the original record alive.

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.text: Scout Nyx. I refused the cleanup order. They put me beside you for administrative convenience.

lines.speaker: vale
lines.text: Can you pilot the stealth frame?

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.text: Open the bay and find out.

lines.speaker: kell
lines.text: Extraction south-west. Patrols are waking up now.
